articles.summary: London, 15th January 2026: Today, the generation defying beauty brand, Rimmel London has joined forced with Red Bull, to create a once-in-a-lifetime performance, that takes Red Bull athlete and five time national All-American gymnast, Lily Smith out of the gym and up to new heights. In her boldest challenge to date, Lily performed a daring 90-second balance beam routine 52 stories above street level!
articles.title: GRAVITY DOESN’T STAND A CHANCE RIMMEL LONDON & RED BULL DELIVER GRAVITY DEFYING LASHES & THRILLING BEAM ROUTINE STUNT

articles.summary: NEW YORK - January 26, 2026 -- Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY), one of the world’s largest beauty companies with a portfolio of iconic brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, and skin and body care, is partnering with Netflix and Shondaland to unveil the first seasonal full fragrance collection inspired by the world of Bridgerton.
articles.title: COTY UNVEILS THE BRIDGERTON FRAGRANCE COLLECTION THAT WILL ENCHANT THE TON
